rationale: The original thesis remains fully intact: price tested resistance just above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($19.06) at $19.11 before rejecting and printing three consecutive lower highs and lower closes on the 1-minute bars back down to $19.02. Broad market conditions have softened further with SPY now down -1.10% and VIXY up 6.76%, while GAP remains pinned in the bottom 20% of its daily range well below the $19.25 VWAP. With the $19.16 invalidation level comfortably respected, holding to target a retest and breakdown of the $18.79 session low is supported by the tape.
